name: Library of Congress loc.gov API
summary: Search and metadata for the Library of Congress's digitized collections (audio recordings, photos, maps, manuscripts, newspapers, books, films...) from the keyless loc.gov JSON API.
notes: Keyless. Every call here carries fo=json for a JSON answer.
Strict rate limit: 20 requests per minute for this API; going over blocks you for an hour. Under heavy traffic you may get 429 or a CAPTCHA page below that rate; pause when you do.
Paging (c per page, sp page number) stops at the 100,000th result, and some searches fail earlier; narrow with fa filters instead of paging deep.
Facet values in fa are not controlled vocabularies, so an exact value may miss variants.
Catalog (MARC) records are not served here, only digitized items, collections and their metadata.

endpoints.name: Search the digitized collections
endpoints.summary: Items, collections and web pages matching keywords, with facets and paging.

q.description: Keywords across metadata and available full text (including video transcripts).

fa.description: Filters as name:value joined with '|': access-restricted, digitized, contributor, language, location, subject, online-format, original-format, partof.

c.description: Results per page; 25 by default, keep it at 1,000 or less.

at.description: Only these attributes, comma-separated, dot notation for sub-attributes (e.g. item,resources or item.data).
